name: Nynnyaw
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nynnyaw, also written Nynniaw, is a Welsh hero. He was an obscure king, and Beli the god was his father. With his brother Peibaw he waged a war that destroyed all the land. The cause was their disagreement over astrological interpretations. Few wars began for so slight a reason. As a punishment the pair were changed into beasts.
